content:
Maya: heads up — deploying experimental prompt-router v2 to prod (canary 5%). I’m seeing error spikes from the new endpoint within the first minute. Rolling back if it doesn’t stabilize. :warning:
SRE-Bot: Incident created — INC-1971 — High 5xx rate on /v1/prompt-route (auto-detected). Paging oncall.
Oncall-Josh: on it, joining call. can everyone drop quick context: what changed in this rollout?
Maya: we pushed a routing change that splits traffic to /prompt-route/exp endpoint for 5% of traffic, code + config. No DB schema changes.
Oli: metrics — 5xx from exp endpoint only, tail latency up to 3.2s at p99 for those requests. Overall customer-facing error rate ~0.6% but for affected customers it's higher.
DevOps-Ade: can we FF-kill it quickly? Feature flag is exp_prompt_router_v2, scoped to traffic_slice=5.
Jordan: agree — FF kill is fastest. If toggle fails, fallback is an immediate rollback of the deployment.
EngLead-Li: prioritize kill switch; rollback is noisier. Also start a small sampling of logs for the 5xx to see cause.
Maya: trying the kill now. running: `opsctl ff toggle --env=prod --flag=exp_prompt_router_v2 --state=off`
Maya: <running>
Maya: CLI output: SUCCESS — flag exp_prompt_router_v2 set to OFF (propagation ~10s).
SRE-Bot: Action logged: feature_flag_toggle by Maya. Notifying routers to refresh config.
Oli: I'm seeing rollout drop from 5% -> 0.3% within 15s. p99 latency for overall service trending back down.
Oncall-Josh: good. Keep an eye for error tail. Any indication of data corruption or misrouted KV cache?
DevOps-Ade: logs show new endpoint returning 502s due to a mismatch in expected request shape from compiler selection path. Looks like v2 expects a different header set.
Jordan: that explains the 502s. If config change required, we should patch in canary then re-enable.
CS-Zoe: we have an enterprise customer on the canary slice that reported timeouts to support. Looping them once we confirm mitigation.
EngLead-Li: assign postmortem: Maya + DevOps-Ade + Oli + Jordan. CS-Zoe to draft customer comms.
Maya: creating incident doc now and will attach logs/snippets. For immediate timeline: time of deploy 1971028625, detection 1971028634, FF kill at ~1971028646.
Oncall-Josh: I’ll keep the page open for 30m. If stable for 20m, we declare mitigated and start root-cause.
SRE-Bot: Incident INC-1971 status -> mitigated by feature flag kill at 1971028646. Monitoring window started.
Oli: after kill, 5xx rate returned to baseline within 40s. p50/p95 latencies unaffected. No sign of retries causing cascade.
DevOps-Ade: saving diagnostic snippets:```
# tail of router logs
[1971028640] exp-route recv payload headers: {x-route-ver: v2}
[1971028641] exp-route failed validation: missing header x-model-arch
[1971028642] internal router -> upstream: 502 Bad Gateway
```
Jordan: next steps: reproduce in staging with header mismatch, prepare a small patch to accept legacy headers w/ fallback, re-run canary at 1% then 5%.
Maya: will coordinate a controlled restart for canary next week after patch and run smoke tests. No rollback needed.
CS-Zoe: I’ve pinged the customer and told them we had a degraded experience affecting a small % of requests, issue mitigated, follow-up comms to come.
EngLead-Li: postmortem owners assigned. Please capture timeline, cause (router header mismatch), detection tooling notes (auto-detect worked), and mitigation steps. Add a recommended runbook entry for FF kill + verification.
Oncall-Josh: handing off to Jordan for tomorrow’s oncall to follow-up on re-rollout plan. I’ll mark incident timeline and close active pager.
Jordan: took handoff. I’ll own re-deployment plan and coord with Maya & Ade.
SRE-Bot: Pager closed by Oncall-Josh. Incident INC-1971 moved to postmortem state.
Maya: thanks all. Quick note for the postmortem: include exact FF command, propagation time, and the affected customers list from CS-Zoe.
CS-Zoe: will attach support tickets and customer-facing message draft.
DevOps-Ade: adding unit/e2e tests to validate header compatibility. Target: ship patch and run canary by Tue.
